summary: Anika Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a Fifth Amendment to its existing credit agreement with Bank of America, increasing the revolving line of credit to $50 million with a possible $100 million accordion feature, maturing July 10, 2031. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR plus 0.25%-1.25% based on leverage ratio, with commitment fees of 0.20%-0.30% on unused portions. The facility includes standard financial covenants (leverage/interest coverage ratios) and grants a first-priority lien on substantially all assets. This is a routine credit facility amendment to refinance or extend existing debt—not a special situation such as a capital return, restructuring, or acquisition. No deal terms apply, and no strategic event is disclosed.
